artworks.title: Entry of M. de Couvonge and M. de Chalabre
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.5 × 24.4 cm (6 1/8 × 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image showing a procession of mythical creatures and figures moving across a barren landscape. The entities and human figures seem to be interacting along a pathway, amidst swirling smoke and flames. The detailed linework emphasizes the dynamic motion and surreal nature of the creatures, which include a dragon-like beast and other hybrids with horns and exaggerated features. The background features textured sky and abstract forms.

artworks.title: Entry of M. le Comte de Brionne, Grand Chamberlain of His Highness,Representing Jason
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.6 × 24.4 cm (6 1/8 × 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing depicting mythological elements. The image is divided into three sections. The top section shows a tall ship with multiple sails and a figurehead on the prow sailing in water, surrounded by figures reminiscent of mythological sea creatures. 

In the lower left section, there is a large tree with dense foliage on rocky terrain, with a dragon or serpent curled around its base. 

In the lower right section, a building with a domed roof is situated on large rocks. A winged creature is depicted playing a horn or trumpet on the rocks near the building. The drawing showcases intricate lines and shading, adding depth and detail to the natural and architectural features.

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.3 × 24.1 cm (6 × 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains a variety of shapes and lines forming surreal scenes. In the upper portion, an abstract composition shows a large winged creature carrying men in armor across water, next to a two-headed bird walking on land attached to a dinosaur-like creature. Below, ornate carriages with intricate designs are drawn by a mix of creatures, including winged beings and animals resembling dogs or lions, carrying mythical characters. The scene combines familiar and abstract elements in a parade-like fashion.

artworks.title: Entry of His Highness, Representing the Sun
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.5 × 24.3 cm (6 1/8 × 9 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features elaborate floats and scenes. The upper half shows two carriages drawn by horse-like creatures. One float has a figure radiating light, while the other includes various figures, fountains, and plant decorations. The lower portion depicts figures in rugged terrain engaged in a laborious task, along with intricately arranged figures on a wave-like platform. The drawing emphasizes texture and ornamentation with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Entry of His Highness on Foot
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior procession scene. The scene shows a grand hall with a vast audience seated on either side, observing a ceremonial event. The high, arched ceiling is decorated with patterns and chandeliers. At the far end, there is a focal point, potentially an altar or a throne, under a luminous cloud-like formation. The hall is filled with audience members seated in an orderly manner, while the central aisle is occupied by various figures, possibly performers or ceremonial guards, presenting a grand and formal atmosphere. The drawing conveys formality, scale, and the opulence of a ceremonial event.

artworks.title: Combat at the Barrier
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.7 × 24.5 cm (6 3/16 × 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an indoor combat event in a grand hall. The venue is richly decorated with detailed architectural elements, including a coffered ceiling with intricate patterns. Spectators are watching from balconies and the main floor as two figures engage in combat at the center. To the right, a group of people appear to be organizing additional activities, with columns and chandeliers adding to the grandeur of the setting.

artworks.title: Entry of M. de Couvonge and M. de Chalabre [extra plate]
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring mythical creatures and humans in a dynamic scene. The artwork shows various figures in action, including winged beasts and a central dragon or serpentine creature. Some figures carry sticks or weapons. In the background, the scene is set in a rocky landscape with architectural elements. The figures and action are depicted with intricate detail and a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.medium: etching//plate cut into six pieces (1969.15.96-101): this piece is part 1 of 6
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large bird surrounded by figures in the background. The bird has its wings spread wide, with detailed feather patterns. In the background, there is a gathering of figures. The line work is intricate, employing hatching to convey texture and depth, creating contrast between the bird and the figures. The composition suggests a story of grandeur or symbolism.

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.medium: etching//plate cut into six pieces (1969.15.96-101): this piece is part 2 of 6
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical scene featuring a swan and a small figure. The drawing shows a small, humanoid figure riding on the back of a large swan. The swan is depicted with detailed feathers and a long neck, while the small figure is whimsical with one arm raised and one hand holding what looks like a bow. There is text at the top in calligraphic style, along with the signature "Callot fe."

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.medium: etching//plate cut into six pieces (1969.15.96-101): this piece is part 3 of 6
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a creature with soldiers on its back. The illustration portrays a large, mythical animal with the body of an elongated beast, bearing resemblance to a dragon or sea-serpent, with a lizard-like head and clawed feet. Atop its back, there are armored soldiers holding upright spears and shields. The soldiers are drawn in classical armor, reminiscent of Roman or ancient warriors, complete with plumed helmets. The creature's elongated tail curves towards the edge of the drawing.

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.medium: etching//plate cut into six pieces (1969.15.96-101): this piece is part 4 of 6
artworks.description: This drawing shows a chariot with a figure holding a spear and circular object, being pulled by a winged figure. The chariot is intricately decorated with swirling designs, supported by two wheels. The winged figure is muscular and holding a scythe and an hourglass with wings. The drawing is executed in a detailed and classical style, with careful line work conveying movement and elegance.

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.medium: etching//plate cut into six pieces (1969.15.96-101): this piece is part 5 of 6
artworks.description: This is an image of a chariot being pulled by a dragon-like creature. The chariot is ornately decorated with swirling patterns and a detailed seat. The dragon-like creature has wings, scales, and clawed feet. The drawing is detailed, with precise lines and shading used to depict the texture and form of both the chariot and the creature. The scene suggests a mythical or legendary setting.

artworks.title: Entry of Monseigneur Henry de Lorraine, Marquis de Moy, under the Name of Pirandre
artworks.medium: etching//plate cut into six pieces (1969.15.96-101): this piece is part 6 of 6
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 11.5 cm (2 3/4 × 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate chariot being pulled by two dogs. The chariot is intricately designed with swirling patterns and features feminine busts on its side. The two animals at the front are depicted with detailed musculature and are harnessed to the chariot. The chariot is elevated on large, decorative wheels, and the drawing is executed with fine lines and meticulous attention to detail.

artworks.title: The Carrière at Nancy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand procession in a city street, featuring two rows of multi-storied buildings on each side of the street and a busy scene with carriages, horse riders, and people gathering for a ceremonial or festive event. The composition is symmetrical, leading the viewer's eye towards a distant square in the background. The architecture features rows of windows and ornate facades, rich in historical and cultural context. In the top center, there is decorative text describing the scene. The style resembles 17th-century etchings, capturing a lively moment of public life with intricate detail and movement.

artworks.title: The Review
artworks.description: The image depicts a military assembly with soldiers in formations, some standing and others marching. Figures on horseback oversee the troops, with one in the foreground observing. The scene includes artillery on carts, flags, and a sense of movement and discipline. The tone is monochromatic with intricate historical military details.

artworks.title: The Martyrs of Japan
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.8 × 11.3 cm (6 5/8 × 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting crucifixions. The image shows a series of robed figures displayed on crosses, with soldiers on horseback below and angelic beings in the sky above.

artworks.title: The Holy Family at Table
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.1 x 17.1 cm (7 1/2 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures. The person on the left is seated at a table, shown from the side, with the upper part of their body visible. They are adorned with a halo around the head, hair tied back with a ribbon, and wearing a long-sleeved garment with a waist apron. The central figure stands, facing the seated individual, with a halo and partially obscured by a hooded robe. To the right, another figure is seated, with hands on the table and a large halo around their head. This figure's hair is shorter and slightly tousled, wearing a collared garment. The scene includes a round table topped with a lit candle, a goblet, a loaf of bread, and a plate. The background features a texture, possibly a patterned or weave-like design, enclosed within a decorative circular border.

artworks.title: The Combat of Avigliana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 36.2 × 54 cm (14 1/4 × 21 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching depicting a wide landscape. In the foreground, soldiers are engaged in battle with banners and horses. Beyond, there are hills with structures and troops battling. The horizon shows distant mountain ridges. The etching has intricate lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of black, white, and gray. A decorative frieze frames the scene with military elements.

artworks.title: View of the Louvre
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.9 x 33.8 cm (6 5/8 x 13 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a cityscape with a bustling river scene from a slight elevation. The horizon is situated in the upper third of the composition, with the river extending towards buildings and hills in the distance. The scene includes detailed buildings along the riverbanks, a round tower as a prominent landmark, various boats with figures and flags on the river, and a blend of old architectural structures in the background. The etching style features intricate linework showcasing architectural details and water movement. The color palette is monochromatic with dark ink lines on light paper.

artworks.title: View of the Pont Neuf
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.4 × 34.5 cm (6 7/8 × 13 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a historical cityscape with a bustling river scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a broad view of the area. The horizon is low, filled with buildings and a bridge spanning the waterway. The structures show intricate architectural detailing. Small boats and figures are visible on the river and shoreline. The scene captures interactions among people, animals, and watercraft. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, emphasizing textures of architecture and water. The color palette is monochrome with varying shades of brown. The sky has softly rendered clouds.

artworks.title: The Ordeal by Arrows (Saint Sebastian)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.3 × 32.8 cm (6 7/16 × 12 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a view of architectural ruins with various figures engaged in activities. The central perspective leads the eye through a broad path where people are active. Ruined buildings, resembling ancient Roman architecture, appear on both sides. Delicate lines create texture and depth in the etching-style illustration, with a monochromatic color palette. Figures on horseback and foot, some with weapons, are close to the viewer. Clusters of people gather around the ruins, with more structures and figures visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: The image shows two figures captured in full-length view within a draped interior. The person on the left appears to be stepping forward with one leg, reaching out towards the other, with an elaborate hairstyle composed of curls and waves. This figure is dressed in a voluminous gown with detailed puffed sleeves and a patterned bodice. The gown's fabric texture suggests a rich, heavy material. The figure on the right is kneeling, with a head similar in hairstyle to the first, though partly obscured by their posture. This person also wears a flowing garment, with visible embroidery or lace detail on the sleeve. Both figures are involved in a scene around a bed with thick, textured curtains drawn to the sides, revealing a heavily shadowed background. The foreground features striped or patterned draperies and a floor without distinct patterning. The scene is intricate and detailed, with a sense of drama enhanced by the use of shading and texture in the artwork.

artworks.title: The Cavalry Combat with Pistols
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cavalry charge scene. The artwork depicts numerous mounted figures charging across a battlefield. The horses are in full motion, with a sense of movement conveyed by the lines and poses. Plumes of smoke rise into the air, and there are fallen figures and horses on the ground, suggesting conflict. The lines are detailed, capturing the tension and action of the moment.

artworks.title: The Cavalry Combat with Swords
artworks.description: The drawing shows a chaotic battle scene with cavalry and fallen soldiers engaged in intense struggle. Horses are ridden by soldiers wielding swords and lances amidst a flurry of activity. Smoke rises above the battlefield, indicating turmoil and gunfire. The intricate lines and detailing convey the frenzied movement and emotion of the moment. Banners and flags are raised amidst the chaos, adding to the historical atmosphere.
